title: Harness Bridge FinalResult
description: Terminal result returned inside harness_wait and harness_cancel responses. Field names, optionality and the status enum match crates/xuanling-harness-bridge/src/jobs.rs FinalResult exactly. Optional fields are omitted when absent, as in the Rust serialization.

job_id.description: Instance-scoped job identity returned by harness_submit.

instance_id.description: Bridge instance that accepted the job.

request_id.description: Caller-chosen request identity used for instance-local deduplication.

harness.description: Worker adapter id: codex, claude, dsh or zcode.

status.description: Terminal status. completed means the native run succeeded; it is not an acceptance verdict by the controller.

worker_final_output.description: Bounded worker final answer. Omitted when no final answer was produced. Redaction or truncation is reported by redacted and output_complete, never by presenting altered text as complete.

output_complete.description: False when the final answer was truncated, redacted, or the native stream was incomplete.

redacted.description: True when known secret patterns or configured secret values were replaced in the final output.

exit_code.description: Native worker exit code when it was observed.

error.description: Native or execution failure attached to the terminal state.

delivery_error.description: Capture or delivery problem that does not rewrite the worker terminal state (for example RESULT_TOO_LARGE).

cleanup.description: Process containment snapshot taken when the result was formed.

report_path.description: Published Markdown result path; present only when save_result was true and publication succeeded.

report_error.description: REPORT_WRITE_FAILED when the optional Markdown result could not be published; the worker result is preserved.

started_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp when the worker started.

finished_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp when the result was formed.

code.description: Stable error code from contracts/tools.json error_codes, or a native classification code.

message.description: Safe, bounded diagnostic. Never a full raw stdout/stderr stream, raw environment or credential value.

confirmed.description: True only after process-tree termination has been confirmed, not merely signalled.

detail.description: Optional bounded explanation, typically present when confirmed is false.
